summary: 10.0.34.10 Enterprise Release - Complete Desktop Parity for Payment Due Status & Return Workflows across Sales & Purchase Registers
highlights: 1. Sales & Purchase Register Due Column: Full 1:1 Desktop parity with dueLabel / due(p) semantic cell badges (Settled, Overdue by X days, Due today, Due in X days, Awaiting Approval, Return Overdue, Return Due)
2. Return Payment Workflow Parity: Updated payment status logic to render Return Pending Approval, Return Paid, Return Partial, and Return Pending
3. Detail Drawers Due Tracking: Synchronized Sales inline drawer, Sales details modal, and Purchase inspect drawer with authoritative due dates and return settlement schedules
4. Centralized Runtime Version: Bumped version registry, DOM injectors, and login badges to 10.0.34.10
